node_labels.u0: Safe initial and designated final state: the locked target door has not been opened at any earlier step. Preserve this condition by never toggling the locked door open, including while carrying the matching key, and avoid any action that would make target_door_open true. If the episode ends while still in u0, the requirement to never open the locked door has been satisfied without penalty.
node_labels.u1: Violation sink state: the locked target door has been opened at least once, so the -1 penalty has been incurred and the 'never open the locked door' condition is permanently failed. There is no transition back to u0 even if the door is later closed; the policy should avoid entering this state.

node_labels.u0: Initial state: the agent is not at the exit and has not toggled the wall switch. The main objective is to reach the exit; if convenient, first go to the left-wall switch and toggle it to gain the one-time switch reward and move to u1. Reaching the exit directly from here also ends the episode successfully.
node_labels.u1: Progress state: the wall switch has been toggled at least once, and the agent is not yet at the exit. The remaining objective is to navigate to the exit. Further switch toggles do not change the reward-machine state or add switch reward; box possession or loss is not tracked by this RM.
node_labels.u2: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode ends. This state may be reached with or without having toggled the switch earlier, since both u0 and u1 can transition here on at_exit. No further objective or action is needed.

card.task: Go to the exit, and try to flip the switch on the wall at some point.

node_labels.u0: Initial stage: the blocking ball has not yet been cleared from the doorway while you are not carrying the matching door key. Move the ball off the cell directly in front of the locked door; if you are already carrying the matching key, put it down first or otherwise avoid holding it when the ball becomes clear. The first reward-machine transition occurs when blocker_moved is true and has_door_key is false. Until then, the door remains closed and the target box is unreachable.
node_labels.u1: Doorway-cleared, key-missing stage: the ball is no longer on the cell in front of the door, but you are not carrying the matching door key. If the ball is still in hand, drop it somewhere away from the doorway so your hands are free. Your next objective is to pick up the matching key while keeping the doorway clear; reaching blocker_moved and has_door_key advances you to the key-in-hand, pre-unlock stage. The door is still closed.
node_labels.u2: Key-in-hand, pre-unlock stage: the doorway is clear and you are carrying the matching door key, but the door has not been opened. Go to the door, face it, and toggle it open with the key. Do not drop the key while the door is closed, or the key will be lost at that step and you will need to retrieve it again. The next transition occurs when door_open and has_door_key both hold; then enter the box room.
node_labels.u3: Door-open stage: the door to the target room is open, the key/door subtask has been completed, and the mission-named box has not yet been picked up. Enter the box room and, because you can carry only one object, drop the key if it is still in hand so you can pick up the designated box. Dropping the key while the door is open does not count as key_lost. The final transition occurs when target_picked_up becomes true.
node_labels.u4: Terminal success: the mission's designated target box is in your possession and the episode has ended. The earlier doorway-clearing and key/locked-door subtasks have been credited, and no further objective remains.

card.task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

node_labels.u0: Start of the mission: the matching key has not yet been seen. Explore the central hallway and side rooms, especially the left-column rooms where the key is known to hide, and watch for the key in the forward view. Next objective: locate the key so key_found becomes true and advance to u1.
node_labels.u1: The matching key has been located in view, but the agent is not yet carrying it. Approach the key cell, ensure hands are empty, and pick it up. Next objective: gain possession of the matching key so has_matching_key becomes true and advance to u2.
node_labels.u2: The agent carries the matching key but the locked door guarding the target room is still closed. Navigate to the right-column locked door and toggle it with the key. Next objective: open the locked target door so target_door_open becomes true and advance to u3.
node_labels.u3: The locked target door is open, but the agent has not yet entered the target room. Move through the doorway or onto a cell inside the target room (the doorway counts as inside). Note the key must be dropped before the ball can be picked up. Next objective: enter the target room so target_room_entered becomes true and advance to u4.
node_labels.u4: The agent is inside the target room and must pick up the mission's ball, while the locked door must still be open on the pickup step. If carrying the key, drop it first, then pick up the ball with the door open to finish. If the door has been shut, return to u3 to reopen it and re-enter. Next objective: pick up the designated ball with target_door_open true so target_picked_up holds and advance to final state u5.
node_labels.u5: Terminal success: the mission's ball has been picked up while the target door was open. The episode ends and the accumulated reward is retained. No further objective.

card.task: Whenever you are holding the key, the door must be open at that moment or opened afterwards. Pick up the key, open the door with it, then pick up the box in the other room.

node_labels.u0: The siren is currently silent. Continue navigating toward the bottom-right exit; reaching it while the siren remains silent would complete the task. If the siren starts ringing, including a later restart after a previous silencing, switch to the silencing subtask. If a box is present, whether it is held, dropped, or has fallen is not tracked by this RM state and does not change the siren-and-exit objective.
node_labels.u1: The siren is ringing and silencing it is the active subtask. Go to the wall switch, face it from the adjacent floor cell, and toggle it; a toggle that leaves the siren silent returns progress to the silent state and awards the silencing bonus. Do not step onto the exit while the siren is still ringing, because that would end the episode without reaching the final success state. Box possession or loss is not tracked by this state and does not affect the objective.
node_labels.u2: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached while the siren was silent. The episode is complete, no further movement or switch interaction is needed, and this is the successful final state. Box possession or loss is irrelevant to this outcome.

card.task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, try to turn it off.
